Extreme slow-motion macro of deep sapphire epoxy resin pouring in one unbroken continuous ribbon into a shallow round mould on a matte black backdrop. Locked-off camera, no hands and no people anywhere in frame. The ribbon falls at a steady even rate from the first frame to the last and the pool level barely changes, so the clip loops seamlessly with no visible cut. Shot at high frame rate and slowed for fluid viscosity — palette limited to deep ocean #08283A, obsidian #080A0E, sapphire #164E6B and muted champagne gold #B89B63; single soft directional key with warm rim fill; matte surfaces, no plastic sheen; cool shadows; editorial product-photography realism; shallow depth of field; no text, no logos, no watermarks, no faces.

videos.cullNote: Candidate a is disqualified three times over: 5s is under §15.3's 6–16s floor, its pool fills from empty to full so frames 1 and 6 cannot sit together in a loop, and its warm tan backdrop is outside the locked palette. Candidate b holds a near-constant pool level across all six sampled frames — which is what makes a seamless loop possible — on an obsidian ground with a champagne rim and sapphire resin. plannedSets.$comment: docs/transformation-audit.md §10.3's generation plan, the batch-D slice of it (SET A–F, 28 entries). Nothing here has been generated — candidates stays empty, keeper stays null and there is no master path until an owner works the queue on an ordinary machine (the Higgsfield CDN answers 403 to this session's egress policy, same as every other entry in this file). The fetch script cannot conjure these out of a prompt: generate it, then `node scripts/media-v3-fetch.mjs --promote <id> <url> [<url>]` records the results and moves the row on from status planned, after which the ordinary --candidates cull and default build handle it like any asset (SET F loops build through media-v3-video-fetch.mjs). `--planned` prints the queue and that whole sequence. Every still prompt already carries promptSuffix, which itself carries REDESIGN §15's "no faces, no logos, no text" clause. scripts/media-v3-preflight.mjs and bundled-media.test.ts both skip status: "planned" entries on purpose — there is no master file to check yet, and checking for one would fail every entry in this object by design.
